item.title: Six Flags Magic Mountain opens after 'all clear' given in response to bomb threat
item.description: Six Flags Magic Mountain is open after a scare on Monday morning delayed the theme park's normal hours of operation.

item.title: Bay Area mom seeks justice after sketches of son's killers from 2013 released
item.description: San Jose police have released sketches of two possible suspects in the 2013 stabbing death of 17-year-old Anthony Santa Cruz, renewing efforts to solve a case that remains unsolved more than a decade later.

item.title: Oakland home values drop more than 11% over past year, marking one of steepest declines in nation
item.description: In the latest data from real estate company Zillow, the typical home value in Oakland fell 11.4% in the past year to about $716,000, adjusted for inflation. The decline has led some to label the city one of the toughest housing markets in the country.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Cool, foggy start to the week
item.description: Cooler weather arrives Tuesday with fog, clouds, and spotty drizzle through midweek. Coastal highs stay in the low 60s while inland areas reach the mid 80s. Warmer weather returns late week before a brief cooldown Saturday and sunnier Sunday.

item.title: e.l.f. Cosmetics co-founder preparing to become Catholic priest
item.description: Scott Vincent Borba moved in glamorous circles during his years in the beauty industry, a period he now describes as defined by excess and pride. The Bay Area native is scheduled to be ordained in Visalia by the Diocese of Fresno, a path considered uncommon in the Catholic Church.

item.title: Preliminary magnitude 7.6 earthquake strikes near Tonga in the South Pacific Ocean, USGS says
item.description: A strong preliminary magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck near Tonga in the South Pacific Ocean, prompting coastal evacuations but no wider tsunami warnings.

item.title: Senators consider deal to fund Homeland Security but not ICE enforcement as airport lines snarl
item.description: "All I can say is that the discussions have been very positive and productive, and hopefully headed in the right direction," said Senate Majority Leader John Thune, R-S.D.

item.title: Dog reunited with family 11 years after being stolen from backyard in Philadelphia
item.description: After more than decade apart, a dog that was stolen from a Philadelphia backyard was reunited with his family in an emotional and heartwarming moment.

item.title: San Jose residents plagued by mail theft with stolen master keys amid ongoing investigation
item.description: Concerned residents have been reporting issues of mail theft in San Jose, where thieves have been using master keys to steal credit cards, checks and other important mail.

item.title: Foster City declares emergency after cyberattack forces city computer system offline for days
item.description: Following a ransomware attack, Foster City officials say they took most of their computer systems offline as a precaution after discovering suspicious activity. Days later, the issue is still ongoing and public services remain limited.

item.description: He has performed at countless recitals and competitions, although his legs are not yet long enough to reach the pedals.
